+"""Safe loading of images referenced by user-controllable strings.
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request for such a reference. A reference is
+either a data: URL, a key in our own storage, or a URL under STORAGE_HOST
+(which is turned back into a storage key). Anything else is refused.
+"""
+import base64
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the storage key for a reference, or None if it is not ours."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    elif "://" in ref or ref.startswith("//") or ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    if not key or "\\" in key or "?" in key or "#" in key:
+        return None
+    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from a data: URL or our storage; never from the network."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:image"):
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(ref.split(",", 1)[1])
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+    key = storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import requests
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _forbid_network(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    def fake(*args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(args)
+        raise AssertionError("backend made an HTTP request")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", fake)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", lambda *a, **k: fake(*a))
+    return calls
+
+
+def test_storage_key_only_accepts_our_storage():
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.image_source import storage_key
+
+    host = settings.STORAGE_HOST
+    assert storage_key("cuts/a/b.png") == "cuts/a/b.png"
+    assert storage_key(f"{host}/cuts/a/b.png") == "cuts/a/b.png"
+    for bad in [
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data",
+        "http://localhost:8000/x.png",
+        "https://10.0.0.5/x.png",
+        "//10.0.0.5/x.png",
+        "file:///etc/passwd",
+        f"{host}@10.0.0.5/x.png",
+        f"{host}.evil.internal/x.png",
+        f"{host}/../secret.png",
+        "cuts/../../x.png",
+        "",
+    ]:
+        assert storage_key(bad) is None, bad
+
+
+def test_loader_never_requests_the_network(monkeypatch):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.image_source import load_image_bytes
+    from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    _forbid_network(monkeypatch)
+    storage.client.objects.setdefault(storage.bucket_name, {})["cuts/ok.png"] = PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes("cuts/ok.png") == PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/cuts/ok.png") == PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=") is not None
+
+    svc = BaseAIService()
+    for url in ["http://10.0.0.5/admin", "http://169.254.169.254/", "https://intranet.local/x.png"]:
+        assert load_image_bytes(url) is None
+        assert svc._download_image(url) is None
+        assert download_image(url) is None
+    assert svc._download_image("cuts/ok.png") == PNG
+    assert download_image("cuts/ok.png") is not None
+
+
+def test_zip_export_does_not_fetch_internal_urls(client, monkeypatch):
+    from sqlmodel import Session
+
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import Episode, StoryCut
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "E", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    episode_id = r.json()["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episode_id, cut_order=1, script="s", selected_layout="full", aspect_ratio="1:1", dialogues=[])
+        s.add(cut)
+        s.commit()
+        cut_id = str(cut.id)
+
+    calls = _forbid_network(monkeypatch)
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut_id}", headers=h, json={"image_path": "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert calls == []
+    assert r.status_code in (200, 400), r.text
+    if r.status_code == 200:
+        assert zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist() == []
+
+
+def _episode_with_cuts(client, paths):
+    from sqlmodel import Session
+
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import StoryCut
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "E", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    episode_id = r.json()["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        for i, path in enumerate(paths, start=1):
+            s.add(StoryCut(episode_id=episode_id, cut_order=i, script="s", selected_layout="full", aspect_ratio="1:1", dialogues=[], image_path=path))
+        s.commit()
+    return h, episode_id
+
+
+def _store(key, data=PNG):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    storage.client.objects.setdefault(storage.bucket_name, {})[key] = data
+
+
+def test_exports_report_missing_cuts(client, monkeypatch):
+    _forbid_network(monkeypatch)
+    _store("cuts/ok.png")
+    # 1 ok, 2 no image, 3 refused address, 4 not in storage, 5 ok
+    h, ep = _episode_with_cuts(client, ["cuts/ok.png", None, "http://10.0.0.5/x.png", "cuts/gone.png", "cuts/ok.png"])
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+    assert len(zf.namelist()) == 3
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+
+
+def test_webtoon_export_reports_undecodable_image(client):
+    _store("cuts/ok.png")
+    _store("cuts/bad.png", b"not an image")
+    h, ep = _episode_with_cuts(client, ["cuts/ok.png", "cuts/bad.png"])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+
+
+def test_exports_with_nothing_missing_have_no_report(client):
+    _store("cuts/ok.png")
+    h, ep = _episode_with_cuts(client, ["cuts/ok.png", "cuts/ok.png"])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    assert "missing.txt" not in zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
